issue: Bright flash during window/menu fade in explicit HDR capture
cause: Blur preparation applied normalized-linear-to-nits scaling to CM_TRANSFER_FUNCTION_LINEAR pixels that already stored absolute nits. At fractional window opacity, the blurred background was amplified by the 10000-nit range and clipped during PQ export. Fully opaque windows skipped that blur path.
fix: Skip toNit for CM_TRANSFER_FUNCTION_LINEAR, consistent with doColorManagement. Normalized, PQ, sRGB and extended-linear inputs retain their existing conversions.

environment.foreground: sRGB ARGB8888 white/gray window over native RGB10 PQ patches

after.hyprland: locally rebuilt build-hdr/Hyprland with the fixed shader

reproduction: nix shell --inputs-from . nixpkgs#python3 -c python3 debug-tools/hdr-capture/test-blur-fade.py --hyprland PATH_TO_HYPRLAND --tools PATH_TO_CAPTURE_AND_SOURCE_CLIENTS
limitations: Frozen opacity steps isolate the shader defect; the exact Steam/XWayland popup sequence was not replayed.
Neutral blur adjustments isolate unit conversion from artistic brightness/contrast settings.
Production services and animation configuration were not changed or restarted by the agent.
